3: relation/semantic boundary is type-only. Prefixes get strict_related/related bool checks (~L189-192); relation values, responses_related, binding, justification, differing_journal_fields, incarnation_pairs, adapter q_profile and event contents are uninspected; row decisions/q_invoked are trusted restored fields (~L199-210). Consistent with declared order-level scope, but the result must be gated behind the retained auditor and never cited as semantic correctness.

4: precharge soft-refusal blind spot. take(1) (~L182-186) counts only raised exceptions as exhaustion; a non-raising refusal (e.g., take=lambda n: None) yields an uncharged audit still eligible for 'supported', contradicting the exhaustion premise (docstring ~L19-22). Minimal fix: treat falsy return as refusal or assert a monotonic consumption delta.
